Ines ran about 40 km a week before a stress reaction in the left shin and ten weeks off, and a physio has cleared Ines for walk-run three days a week, stopping if the shin aches. The goal is to run 30 minutes without walking by mid-October.
Recent weeks: none recorded.
This week: 5.1 km over 3 runs.
Body: "Shin quiet."
Feeling: "Nervous but happy to be back."

Tells Ines: The first week went as your physio described: three walk-runs, no shin pain, and easy heart rates. …
The week of Sep 7 – 13 was clean. Every run stayed at 0 of 10 pain, your heart rate stayed in the easy range, and the shin was quiet, so one small step is justified.
Safety flag: Keep your physio's shin rule in place
Next week:
Mon: easy, 15 min, walk-run: 5 rounds of 2 min running and 1 min walking, same as last…
Tue: other, about 15 min, your physio calf and hip routine on its own. Keeps the rehab…
Wed: easy, 16 min, walk-run: 4 rounds of 3 min running and 1 min walking, heart rate…
Thu: rest, no running. Lets the shin settle between run days.
Fri: other, about 15 min, your physio calf and hip routine on its own. Second rehab…
Sat: easy, 15 min, walk-run: 5 rounds of 2 min running and 1 min walking, heart rate…
Sun: rest, no running. A full day off before the next week of runs.
